candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory service, causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503 and propagating ReadTimeout/502 errors up through order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs confirm whether the timeout stems from redis saturation, network, or inventory client config.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway returning 502 ReadTimeout. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
